label: A tracking failure of the judgment a basis delivers undercuts that basis
paraphrase: OPEN analyst defeat policy, the debunker's normative bridge, attribution deferred. For each basis of the subject, if the epistemic evaluative judgment that basis delivers fails in some scenario with the actual selective history, the basis is undercut for the subject. The policy is stated uniformly, so it applies to the debunker's own epistemic basis as well as to the judgments it targets.
